plain_text:
Gerald Mohr appears in 255 recordings across 26 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1938 to 1955. The credits here include performer and announcer.

In this archive, you will hear Gerald Mohr most often in The Adventures of Philip Marlowe, Fu Manchu, The Whistler, Lux Radio Theatre, Dr. Christian, Rogues Gallery, Screen Directors Playhouse, and The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show.

Characters credited here include Philip Marlowe, Archie Goodwin, and Johnny Dollar.
